facts.text: Audrey believes that the dogs love going on walks and that it is their favorite part of the day.

evidence.quote: Yeah, they love it! It's their favorite part of the day! Their faces blightens up as soon as I get ready for a walk.

facts.text: Andrew agrees that nature brings happiness to both humans and their pets.

evidence.quote: Of course! Nature always makes us and our pets so happy.

facts.text: Audrey states that dogs and nature bring her joy and peace.

evidence.quote: Definitely! Dogs and nature bring me so much joy and peace.

facts.text: Audrey mentions that the dogs go home with a smile and are tired after their walks.

evidence.quote: They need exercise and to explore - they always go home with a smile and tired.
